svg.title: WISTR fuel maintenance P&ID sheet 2
svg.text: GAS SERVICES AND METERED FUEL CONNECTIONS
Connection markers HP / HS / OG / FA / FR continue on sheet 1. Gas unit 3 serves TK-FM-06 / TK-FM-01 (3D F5/F6); three shared units total.
PDC-FM-03 starts/stops K-FM-03 using PT-FM-95 and PT-FM-96. One unit serves two tanks (six storage regions).
Gas supply: existing room supply interface and common header. Off-gas: existing separate return header to treatment; both
H-O Core / storage position 4 vents - both associated sectors
Common enclosure for storage regions A / B / C
Air connections retained from reference; detailed dampers, cooling internals and external air-header tags remain TBD.
Owner-defined process arrangement. Sizes, ratings, fail positions and detailed controls TBD.
Functional schematic; not to scale. Solid-dot crossings connect; other crossings do not.
